major_finding.finding: The root-to-member hash chain is internally correct, but both evaluator contracts begin with PINNED_CONTRACT_PRESENTED_BY_CALLER. No evaluator-owned non-overridable expected root bundle identity anchors the chain.
major_finding.minimal_attack: A caller can replace the design bundle, lane manifest, evaluator contract, oracle and adapter manifest as one mutually rehashed set, then provide output matching the replacement oracle. Every current internal pin can still match.
minimal_remediation: Freeze EXPECTED_DESIGN_BUNDLE_SHA256 and byte length as evaluator build/review configuration that the caller cannot supply or override.

Begin evaluation only from the fixed archive-relative root bundle and verify its closed duplicate-free bytes before traversing the selected lane manifest, running contract, oracle, adapter manifest and TASK/fixture members.
Allow the caller to provide only lane selection and adapter output, never paths, hashes, bundle, manifest, contract or oracle.
Keep every mismatch, unreadable member or exception on FAIL_CLOSED.

closed_predecessor_findings: Adapter output no longer contains or controls verdict, PASS or FAIL.
Complete row equality against a trusted oracle rejects contradictory enumerated combinations.
Closed key, duplicate key, exact boolean, type, member, hash and exception failure semantics are specified.
The adapter-visible bundle is exactly TASK and fixture; implementation must later prove isolation.
J1 and J2 do not aggregate, compensate or propagate.
EXACT_CONTEXT_CONFORMANCE_ONLY and source_interpretation=NOT_TESTED remain the claim ceiling.

backtrack_options: Use one minimal per-lane evaluator with the exact expected oracle and configuration embedded as reviewed build-time constants.
Stop the model-qualification branch and return to a human-reviewed or deterministic reality experiment that does not depend on model PASS.
